artifacts.title: GitHub integration — receiver ready, live setup pending
artifacts.content:
Implemented signed GitHub ingestion, repository identity checks, durable duplicate protection, normalized development evidence, and same-project task links. The Connections view distinguishes repository configuration from actual signed deliveries.

Local validation: 23 automated tests and a synthetic browser integration check passed. Synthetic fixtures are kept outside this project.

Live activation is pending a secure server-side webhook secret, a public HTTPS receiver with persistent storage, and the GitHub webhook or App configuration. No real provider delivery or AI execution is claimed.

Setup instructions: docs/GITHUB-INTEGRATION.md.

artifacts.title: Workspace foundation — steps 1 and 2
artifacts.content:
Implemented: app-first navigation; server-backed projects, assignments, tasks, notes, support tickets, and recorded activity; version conflict protection; database restart persistence.

Current operation: local single-operator SQLite workspace. Statuses are manual, not agent execution telemetry.

Next: verified GitHub events, an isolated worker, and authenticated project access before external use.

See docs/IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md and docs/WORKSPACE-ARCHITECTURE.md for the implementation and deployment boundaries.
